title: Debris Haul-Off Loads and Per-Load Price, Water Damage Mitigation
content:
**Water Damage Mitigation — pricing the tear-out debris haul-off line**

1. A job's tear-out debris is hauled off once and billed as one debris haul-off line in pickup-truck loads, dated the service date of the job's latest flood cut line, or of its latest pad removal line when it has no flood cut line, or of its latest carpet removal line when it has neither; a job that already carries a debris haul-off line, or that carries no pad removal, carpet removal or flood cut line, is billed no tear-out debris line.
2. The removed flooring area is the total square feet on the job's pad removal and carpet removal lines, and the cut drywall run is the total linear feet on its flood cut lines.
3. The flooring load size is 600 square feet of removed flooring per load. The drywall load size is 120 linear feet of cut drywall per load. The trim load term is zero, the baseboard being detached for reset.
4. The loads are the removed flooring area divided by the flooring load size, plus the cut drywall run divided by the drywall load size, plus the trim load term, the total rounded up to a whole load.
5. The per-load rate is the tier's debris haul-off fee per load. The per-load rate is multiplied by every rate multiplier that applies to the line and then rounded to the cent, half up, and the line amount is the loads multiplied by that rounded per-load rate.
6. Amounts are rounded to the cent, half up.

## Which line dates the haul
| The job carries | The debris haul-off line is dated |
|---|---|
| flood cut lines | the service date of the latest flood cut line |
| pad removal lines but no flood cut line | the service date of the latest pad removal line |
| carpet removal lines only | the service date of the latest carpet removal line |
| a debris haul-off line already, or none of these tear-out lines | no tear-out debris line is billed |

## Worked figure (hypothetical job)
Inputs chosen for illustration: pad removal lines of 450 square feet and carpet removal lines of 450 square feet, flood cut lines totalling 150 linear feet, and an assumed per-load fee of $180.00 with no rate multiplier applying.
- Removed flooring area: 900 square feet; divided by 600 gives 1.5.
- Cut drywall run: 150 linear feet; divided by 120 gives 1.25.
- Trim load term: zero.
- Total 2.75, rounded up to 3 loads.
- Per-load rate: $180.00. Line amount: 3 loads multiplied by $180.00, that is $540.00.

The rounding up applies once, to the total of the three terms; the per-load rate is rounded to the cent before it is multiplied by the loads.
